verdict.rationale: Kushki documents its own scheduling for recurring work in the payments domain: guides titled "Crea un cargo recurrente" (create a recurring charge) and "Maneja tus cargos calendarizados" (manage your scheduled charges), plus external subscriptions. This covers recurring scheduled charges, not general jobs or workflows, and the evidence is page titles only. Missing for 10: scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows beyond recurring charges, documented schedule configuration details (frequency, cron-like rules, editing or pausing), agent or AI-native interfaces for managing schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
